profile.name: Parthkumar Patel
profile.title: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: MS in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology (3.9 GPA), specializing in full-stack development with React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and LLM/AI integration. Seeking Software Developer and Full Stack Developer roles.

about.bio: I hold an MS in Computer Science from Stevens Institute of Technology (3.9 GPA) and bring hands-on full-stack experience from internships at EventEase and TechBilv Solutions LLP. I build production-grade web applications with React 19, TypeScript, and FastAPI — architecting modular component systems, real-time REST API and WebSocket integrations, and LLM-powered multi-agent workflows. I've shipped responsive interfaces across mobile, desktop, and 4K displays, managed AWS S3 deployments, and integrated AI capabilities into practical full-stack applications. I enjoy owning features end-to-end, collaborating in agile teams, and writing clean, maintainable code.

details: Focus on advanced computer science topics and research

bullets: Built and shipped two greenfield React SPAs and extended an existing codebase for charity golf live scoring and tournament operations, delivering responsive experiences from mobile layouts to 4K TV displays.

Architected modular frontends with React 19, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Redux Toolkit, using reusable component patterns to support live leaderboards, dashboards, and admin workflows.

Integrated end-to-end REST API workflows with Axios for authentication, team onboarding, score submission, leaderboard retrieval, messaging, media uploads, and sponsor content, adding centralized error handling and toast-based user feedback.

Implemented near real-time leaderboard updates via polling and optimized refresh logic for both web and TV-ready views, including sponsor carousels and animated transitions to keep rankings and event information current.

Delivered an admin/dashboard CMS with data-rich tables, CSV/XLSX import flows, and validated forms (React Hook Form, Zod, TanStack Table) to streamline course, golfer, team, communication, and sponsor management for organizers.

Collaborated in a Scrum-based remote team with weekly standups, using Trello for task tracking, Slack for communication, and Git/GitHub for version control and code reviews while assisting with production builds, deployments, and basic testing.
Leveraged AI-assisted coding tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) alongside ESLint and established patterns to accelerate development while maintaining readable, consistent, and maintainable code.
Contributed to client-facing web applications using React.js, redesigning modals, enhancing layouts, and improving navigation elements.
Integrated AI chatbot (Hoori), updated link structures, and implemented alphabetical scrolling for streamlined user experience.
Managed production deployments using Visual Studio 2022, publishing builds and updating projects on AWS-connected IIS hosting servers.
Hosted and configured static websites on AWS S3, gaining hands-on experience with cloud hosting and deployment pipelines.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with client requirements.

projects.name: AI Resume Tailoring Platform
projects.description: Full-stack AI resume workstation that keeps one master resume in YAML and uses LLMs to generate job-specific tailored resumes, score ATS keyword fit, and apply chat-driven edits, shipped as a single Docker container with FastAPI, Next.js, and rendercv PDF rendering.
highlights: Built a full-stack AI resume workstation (Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, SQLite) that maintains a single master resume in YAML and generates job-specific tailored resumes from pasted job descriptions using LLM-driven section selection and rewriting.

Engineered real-time generation and ATS evaluation over Server-Sent Events, streaming LLM output, keyword match scores, and fit critiques to the UI, with LiteLLM providing provider-agnostic access to OpenAI-compatible models.

Automated PDF pipeline with rendercv and Typst, including AI-powered import that converts an uploaded PDF resume into schema-valid YAML and a normalizer layer that repairs LLM-generated YAML before rendering.

Designed a context-aware chat assistant that applies edits directly to the master resume YAML, plus persistent generation rules and a sortable library of every generated resume with one-click PDF re-download.

Exposed 23 REST/SSE endpoints across 7 FastAPI route modules and verified the system with 89 backend unit tests and 13 Playwright end-to-end tests spanning 8 full integration scenarios, including a deterministic LLM mock mode for CI-safe testing.

Orchestrated development with a spec-first, multi-agent Claude Code workflow (design docs, 7 implementation plans, parallel agent builds) and shipped the app as one Docker container serving both the API and the static frontend.

projects.name: SortBoard
projects.description: A responsive React + TypeScript sorting visualizer that animates 6 algorithms in real time using generator-based execution and user-controlled playback for interactive algorithm learning.
highlights: Engineered an interactive sorting visualizer in React 19, TypeScript, and Vite with 6 algorithm implementations (Bubble, Merge, Quick, Insertion, Selection, Heap) to demonstrate algorithm behavior step-by-step.
Implemented generator-based sorting flows and a reusable animation engine in custom hooks, enabling pause, resume, stop, and speed control for smooth real-time playback.
Designed modular UI components and color-state visualization (comparing, swapping, pivot, sorted) to improve concept clarity and reduce cognitive load for learners.
Built configurable controls for array size (10-100) and execution speed (1-100 steps/sec), supporting multiple learning paces and side-by-side algorithm exploration.
Shipped a production deployment pipeline with Vite build + GitHub Pages publishing, delivering a live, accessible web demo for portfolio and interview use.

projects.name: Financial QA Bot
projects.description: Python application that analyzes CSV financial data, answers natural-language questions with rule-based or OpenRouter-backed reasoning, and generates professional financial reports and visualizations.
highlights: Built a CSV-driven financial question-answering pipeline that loads structured data, matches metrics with fuzzy lookup, and returns year-specific insights in plain English.
Implemented a dual-mode QA engine with OpenRouter LLM support and rule-based fallback to keep responses available even without an API key.
Generated automated JSON reports and high-resolution financial charts to streamline analysis, presentation, and stakeholder review.
Added trend detection, best/worst-year analysis, and derived ratio calculations such as net margin, ROA, and asset turnover for stronger decision support.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A responsive, JSON-driven React portfolio that showcases professional experience, projects, skills, certifications, and resume content with a polished recruiter-friendly interface.
highlights: Built a responsive, single-page portfolio in React and TypeScript with section-based navigation, improving discoverability across the full personal brand and career story.
Designed a reusable, JSON-driven content architecture with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components, making it easy to maintain projects, skills, experience, and certifications.
Implemented dark/light mode, scroll progress, back-to-top behavior, and active-section tracking to deliver a polished, accessible user experience.
Integrated live GitHub activity cards, resume preview/download, SEO metadata, and a contact form with toast feedback to improve recruiter engagement.
Deployed to GitHub Pages with custom-domain support, delivering a fast, production-ready portfolio presence.

projects.name: MRTD Validation System (ICAO TD3)
projects.description: Python-based machine-readable travel document encoder, decoder, and validator using the Damm algorithm, with automated testing, coverage, mutation analysis, and performance benchmarking at production-scale record volumes.
highlights: Developed an end-to-end ICAO TD3 MRZ engine (scan, decode, encode, and check-digit validation) with deterministic Damm-based verification and structured mismatch reporting.
Designed and executed 15 automated unit tests with a 100% pass rate, validating normal flows, negative paths, boundary checks, and mutation-killing edge cases.
Achieved 86% line coverage (above the 80% target) and generated full HTML/terminal reports to enforce measurable code quality.
Implemented mutation testing with 406 generated mutants and 137 killed mutants, using findings to identify weak assertions and guide test improvements.
Benchmarked system performance on up to 10,000 records, reaching ~31.5K encode/sec and ~156K decode/sec.

projects.name: MouseMacro
projects.description: A lightweight macOS menu bar automation app that remaps extra mouse buttons to copy/paste shortcuts with global event interception, suppressed default navigation behavior, and real-time usage analytics.
highlights: Designed and shipped a Swift-based menu bar application that remaps mouse Button 4/5 to Cmd+C/Cmd+V, improving copy/paste speed and reducing repetitive keyboard use in daily workflows.
Implemented low-level Quartz Event Tap interception to capture system-wide other-mouse events and suppress native forward/back browser navigation, eliminating shortcut conflicts across applications.
Built robust keyboard macro injection using CGEvent key-down/key-up synthesis with compatibility timing controls, ensuring consistent command execution across macOS apps.
Developed a thread-safe SwiftUI preferences panel with live session metrics (copy/paste counters and last action) backed by @MainActor state management for safe concurrent updates.
Hardened the desktop app experience with Accessibility permission prompts, actionable failure alerts, structured os.log diagnostics, and safe lifecycle cleanup of event taps/run loop resources.

projects.name: Mini Search Engine
projects.description: Python-based mini search engine that crawls and indexes HTML pages, ranks matches by term frequency, and serves results through a Flask web app and CLI.
highlights: Built a Flask search application that indexes local HTML pages and returns ranked results with highlighted matches, snippets, and clickable source pages.
Implemented an inverted-index pipeline with stop-word filtering and text tokenization to support fast full-text search across the document set.
Developed a recursive web crawler to collect and persist up to 10 Wikipedia pages as the searchable corpus.
Added recent-search tracking, output logging, and a dark-mode interface to improve usability.
Delivered a command-line version of the search engine to validate core retrieval logic outside the browser UI.

projects.name: Credit Score Prediction Project
projects.description: Machine learning project that predicts customer credit scores (Poor, Standard, Good) from financial behavior using data cleaning, feature engineering, SMOTE, and model comparison.
highlights: Built an end-to-end credit score classification pipeline on 100,000 customer records, transforming messy financial data into a model-ready dataset through cleaning, imputation, outlier handling, and feature engineering.
Reduced model complexity by applying mutual information feature selection to retain the top predictive variables and improve training efficiency on the credit scoring dataset.
Addressed class imbalance with SMOTE and compared six classifiers, including KNN, Gaussian Naive Bayes, logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, and an MLP neural network.
Analyzed correlations, payment behavior, debt, and credit history patterns to identify the strongest drivers of credit score outcomes for risk-focused decision making.

projects.name: Heart Disease Prediction using KNN, Random Forest, and ANN
projects.description: A machine learning project that predicts heart disease from clinical measurements using cleaned patient data, feature engineering, visualization, and model comparison across KNN, Random Forest, and ANN.
highlights: Developed an end-to-end heart disease prediction workflow in Python, preparing 1,889 clinical records with missing-value checks, outlier handling, encoding, and feature scaling.
Built and evaluated KNN, Random Forest, and ANN classifiers, using confusion matrices, classification reports, and accuracy scoring to compare model performance.
Improved model interpretability by applying mutual information feature selection and visualizing feature importance and data distributions for clinical variables.
Packaged the analysis in an interactive Jupyter Notebook with reusable preprocessing and evaluation steps, supporting clear model comparison for healthcare decision-making.
